description: F-4C-21-MC; first flight 15 February 1965 and taken on charge 9 March 1965; 558th TFS 12th TFW at MacDill then Cam Ranh; with 480th TFS 366th TFW at Da Nang by 1967 which is the same squadron and period as Milwaukee Medal of Honor recipient Capt Lance Sijan; credited with a MiG-17 kill on 14 May 1967 using an SUU-16 gun pod flown by Capt James T Craig Jr and 1st Lt James T Talley callsign Speedo 03; later 356th TFS Misawa 80th TFS Yokota 67th TFS Kadena 35th TFW George 58th TFTW Luke Louisiana ANG 122nd TFS and Oregon ANG 114th TFTS; to AMARC 2 March 1987 as FP0042 then to the NMUSAF loan programme and loaned to Milwaukee County March 1992; displayed in front of the USPS post office at 5500 S Howell Ave in the markings of Sijan's own aircraft 64-0751 which is a different airframe
